Generate 1000 random values from a normal distribution.

```{r}
set.seed(123)
rn <- rnorm(1000, 100, 10)
mean(rn) -> xbar
xbar
S <- sd(rn)
S
```

The mean of `rn` is `r round(xbar,3)` and the standard deviation is `r round(S, 2)`.

* Create a histogram of the values in `rn`.  The histgram is visible in @fig-hist.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: "fig-hist"
#| fig-cap: "Histogram of class junk"

hist(rn)
```
